skills.title: Fighting Alongside
skills.description: Direct damage taken is split between yourself and surrounding friendlies, and for every 20 point of damage split or dodged, the base attack is increased by 2 points, with the increase capped of attack at 100%. Lasts 2 turns.

skills.description: 20% chance of dodging damage when attacked by the Air Force.
